messages:
Rae: Flagging inconsistent terminology across quickstarts and SDK snippets. Some guides use `prompt`, others `instruction`, `input`, or `prompt_text`. New users are confused.
Connor: Agree. We should pick one canonical API name and add a short style rule explaining when to use 'prompt' vs 'instruction' in prose.
Mina: Proposal: canonical param `user_input`. It's explicit and maps to chat, gen, and embeddings. Use 'instruction' in prose when emphasizing imperative tasks, and 'prompt' only in informal quickstarts.
Rae: Good. Action items: 1) Add glossary entry for 'user_input/prompt/instruction'. 2) Update code snippets to `user_input`. 3) Add a docs linter rule to catch deprecated names.
Connor: I'll prototype a docs-mdcheck rule to error on `prompt_text`/`prompt`/`input` in code fences. It can autofix suggestions to `user_input`.
Mina: I'll update representative JS, Python, and Go snippets with before/after examples and add a one-paragraph migration note. Example to show in migration guide:
```js
// before
client.generate({ prompt: 'Summarize this text' })
// after
client.generate({ user_input: 'Summarize this text' })
```
Rae: DocsBot, can you run a scoped grep across /docs/examples and /docs/snippets and open PR branches for obvious matches?
DocsBot: Scanning target folders for deprecated param names. Will open sibling PRs with proposed fixes and post links here when ready.
Connor: Also add a release-note checklist entry so PMs review wording. We should keep the Console UI label as "Prompt" but add a short tooltip: "API param: user_input (formerly prompt_text/prompt)" for one release.
Mina: I'll draft the glossary blurb and the migration paragraph. Rae: please assign the UI tooltip ticket.
Rae: Done. I'll wait for DocsBot PRs then merge after CI green. :thumbsup:
